text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A confidential SWAPO document reveals that it has not made the inclusion of women on its party lists for the upcoming local elections compulsory.

- An already operational community project for the Kxoe-San tribe in western Caprivi, on the nothern eastern shores of the Okavango river, is to make way for the expansion of the Divundu rehabilitation centre, prisons minister Marco Hausiku said.
- The police drug enforcement unit has cracked a drug smuggling syndicate with the arrest of four men found in possession of 6,412 kg of cocaine valued at N$3,2 million.
